Anya: Quick sync on OrbitEdge billing integration -- partner requires per-device hourly files + a consolidated daily reconciliation CSV delivered at 09:00 UTC. Proposal: Redwood emits signed hourly snapshots to partner S3 (or push) and keeps canonical hourly aggregates for audit.
Gwen: They insist partner_hourly is source-of-truth for their customers but will accept Redwood audit copy. They want delta file format documented.
Ranjit: Implementation sketch: ingest canonical events with event_id + event_ts, stream-write per-hour files (sharded by region) to avoid memory pressure, keep raw_event_payload for 30d, and expose a reconciliation API for partner-submitted deltas during a 24h window.
Sofia: Security/ops: require X-Redwood-Signature HMAC header on callbacks; validate event_id uniqueness; stream directly to S3 w/ multipart upload to avoid buffering. Also shard snapshot generator by region to avoid single point load.
Matt: Reconciliation SQL draft to highlight deltas:
```sql
SELECT p.device_id, p.usage_units AS partner_units, r.usage_units AS redwood_units, (p.usage_units - COALESCE(r.usage_units,0)) AS delta
FROM partner_hourly p
LEFT JOIN redwood_hourly r ON p.device_id = r.device_id AND p.snapshot_hour = r.snapshot_hour
WHERE ABS(p.usage_units - COALESCE(r.usage_units,0)) > 0;
```
Sofia: Example hourly payload (kept small):
```json
{
  "snapshot_hour": "2026-03-21T14:00:00Z",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "device_rows": [{"device_id":"orb-001","usage_units":123}],
  "snapshot_id": "snap_20260321_14_euw1_0001"
}
```
Matt: Operational thinkpoints: allow ±2 minute clock skew when bucketing events; flag events that land in grace window. Also define threshold for automatic crediting vs manual dispute.
Gwen: Partner asks for timezone handling doc since devices report local tz; we should publish a short spec that we normalize all reports to UTC billing buckets and include original device_ts.
Anya: Action items: Ranjit/Sofia finalize webhook + streaming writer (due Mar 28); Matt define reconciliation thresholds & dispute SLA (due Mar 30); Gwen confirm S3 vs push preference and sample files (due Mar 26); Anya draft partner spec & runbook and loop in legal for 24h reconciliation clause (due Apr 1).
ingest-bot: TEST: forwarded hourly snapshot to orbitedge-dev (200 OK) snapshot_id=snap_20260321_14_euw1_0001
Ranjit: I'll include ingest_received_ts in partner_hourly table and rotate files hourly to limit object size.
Sofia: We'll add an E2E nightly staging test to validate signatures, file format, and reconciliation outputs.
Anya: Thanks all ":raised_hands:" — I'll compile the spec and ping OrbitEdge afterwards.
